ace_testing_guidance.overview: Testing guidance for ACE integration projects. Testing must be completed before a development task is considered done. Use both positive and negative test cases.

category.name: Unit_Testing
category.description: Test individual message flows or ESQL modules in isolation.

tools.tool: ACE Toolkit Test Suite (ComIbmMQInput test nodes for unit test flows)
SoapUI projects (found in *_SOAPUI_Project directories in this workspace)
curl or Postman for REST/HTTP endpoint testing

checklist.item: Positive case: valid request → expected response (HTTP 200 / SOAP success)
Missing required fields: service returns appropriate error code and message
Invalid field values: service rejects and returns validation error
Malformed XML/JSON: service catches parse error and returns error response
Backend timeout: flow returns timeout error message to caller
Backend returns HTTP 500: flow handles upstream error correctly

category.name: Integration_Testing
category.description: Test the flow end-to-end with real or stub backend systems.

checklist.item: HTTP input to HTTP request to HTTP reply — full round trip
Audit messages written to audit MQ queue (if applicable)
Email notifications sent on error conditions
Properties files loaded correctly for target environment

using_soapui_projects.description: This workspace contains SoapUI project files for most services. Locate the relevant *_SOAPUI_Project directory and use the test cases defined there.

steps.step: Find the SoapUI project XML file in the *_SOAPUI_Project directory.
Open in SoapUI (or SoapUI Open Source).
Set the service endpoint in the project properties to match the target ACE integration server URL (e.g., http://localhost:7080/ServiceName).
Add new test cases for any new operations developed.
Verify responses match expected WSDL/schema structure.

test_case.name: SOAP_Fault_on_backend_error
test_case.description: Simulate a backend HTTP 500. Verify the service returns a SOAP fault with the expected faultcode and faultstring.
test_case.expected_behaviour: HTTP 500 response with SOAP Envelope containing ns:Fault element

test_case.name: Timeout_handling
test_case.description: Simulate a slow backend (delay > timeoutForServer). Verify the service returns a timeout error message and the audit record shows 'Failure' status.

test_case.name: Invalid_endpoint
test_case.description: For gateway flows: call an endpoint not in the routing table. Verify the service returns a clear error saying the endpoint is unknown.

test_case.name: Schema_validation_failure
test_case.description: Submit a SOAP request that violates the WSDL schema (missing element, wrong type). Verify the Validate node catches it and returns a validation error.

ace_command_line_testing.description: ACE provides command-line tools for testing without the Toolkit.

command.name: IntegrationServer_start
command.description: Start a standalone integration server for testing

command.name: mqsibar_deploy
command.description: Deploy a BAR file to the integration server

command.name: mqsichangeproperties
command.syntax: mqsichangeproperties MyBroker -e MyServer -o MyFlow -n property -v value
command.description: Change a User-Defined Property value at runtime

command.name: ibmint_test
command.description: Run ACE unit tests defined in the test project

pre_test.item: BAR file deployed successfully (no deployment errors in system log)
Properties file for target environment applied
Backend systems reachable from the ACE server

post_test.item: All negative/error test cases produce expected error responses
No unexpected exceptions in the ACE system log
No memory leaks or performance degradation under load
